annotation.title_clean: Taxonomy and Definitions for Terms Related to Driving Automation Systems for On-Road Motor Vehicles
annotation.title_en: Taxonomy and Definitions for Terms Related to Driving Automation Systems for On-Road Motor Vehicles
annotation.summary_en: SAE J3016 (April 2021 revision) is the standard taxonomy and set of definitions for six levels of driving automation (Level 0 to Level 5) for on-road motor vehicles. It defines the roles of the human driver, the driving automation system and other vehicle systems. It excludes momentary active safety systems and warning systems.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines six levels of driving automation, from Level 0 (no automation) to Level 5 (full automation).
The level is set by the driving automation feature engaged at a given time, not by the vehicle as a whole.
Allocates roles in the dynamic driving task and DDT fallback among the human driver, the automation system and other vehicle systems.
Excludes active safety systems (ESC, AEB, LKA) and warning-only systems from the taxonomy.
Applies to on-road use on publicly accessible roadways, including parking areas and campuses that permit public access.
